title: ArmorForged
description: Finally makes trims useful by adding passive & active abilities to each trim.
body:
# ⚔️ ArmorForged 

### ArmorForged is a plugin that adds passive and active abilities to the 16 Trims of the game.


- /af gui - To open the trims compendium to check which ability is active and also what ability ( either passive or active ) each trim provides.

- If all the 4 pieces have same trims, player is provided with a "set-bonus" which either adds another ability to the trim or enhances the general ability.

# NOTES
1. This plugin is still in Beta testing and bugs are expected. Report any in the discord server, if found.
2. Most of the abilities ( strength, duration, etc. ) are editable in the config file.
